text:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate observed for /v1/generate across us-west-2. 5xx spike to 18% for the last 3 mins. Pager oncall -> alex, sara. @alex primary, @sara secondary. (alerts: latency/error-rate)

alex: I'm on it. Confirming impact — can someone post recent deploys? :thinking_face:

mike: no deploys in last 30m from CI. Last deploy was 12:05 UTC. I can check autoscale/relay metrics.

alex: grabbing logs now. Running tail on frontend for 3167894289 window.

alex: quick log snippet:
```
2026-03-14T12:58:21Z ERROR handler.go:112 request_id=ldk9k failed kv-cache miss, model-fallback invoked
2026-03-14T12:58:22Z WARN proxy.go:45  upstream 10.3.6.22:429 error 502
2026-03-14T12:59:01Z ERROR router.go:78 batch-split failed: context deadline exceeded
```

sara: seeing the same in prism traces. Errors concentrated on relay-pool-2 (us-west-2a). Throughput unchanged, latency tails rising.

alex: mitigation plan: 1) move traffic off relay-pool-2 -> hot-standby 2) bump relay concurrency to reduce queueing 3) enable model-fallback gracefully if relays continue to error. I'll execute step 1 and 2 now. Note: this will affect capacity for long-running generations.

julia: FYI customer impact: a subset of embeddings and long-chat generation requests may see failures or 503s. I've pinged CS to surface potential customer spikes.

alex: executed traffic re-route to hot-standby (relay-pool-4). Commands used:
```
# shift routing weights
redwoodctl route set relay-pool-2=0.1 relay-pool-4=0.9 --region us-west-2
# increase concurrency
redwoodctl relay update relay-pool-2 --concurrency 64
```

ops-bot: Deployments: none. Autoscaler: stable. Relay-pool-4 healthy. Rolling actions logged (action_id=act-3167894321-1).

sara: after the route change error rate dropped to 3% within 90s. Nice work. Any residual errors in the tails?

alex: tails improved but a few 502s persist from older connections. I'm going to purge stale upstream connections on relay-pool-2 and rotate proxies.

mike: running connection purge script against pool-2 now. ETA ~30s.

alex: purge completed. Observability shows connections drop, 502s nearly gone. Lowering alert threshold for oncall to 5% from 10% for the next 30m while we stabilise.

julia: filing follow-up ticket for detailed post-incident triage and action items. Ticket RED-3421 created: "relay-pool connection thrash during burst -> improve connection drain". Assigned to eng-runtime. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-3421

sara: note for next handoff: primary/secondary for EU shift should verify relay pool health and ensure standby pools have warmed KV caches. We had a small cold-cache penalty after the route switch.

alex: adding runbook pointers in the ticket for the engineer taking triage:
- Runbook: https://internal.redwood/docs/runbooks/relay-failures
- Quick commands used (also in ticket comments)

alex: primary->secondary handoff: I'm handing primary to @sara at 13:15 UTC. I'll remain secondary for 30m overlap to help with follow-ups.

sara: ack. I'll take primary at 13:15 UTC. My notes:
- verify pool health dashboard (relay_pool_health) every 5m
- check kv-cache hit ratio and prefix cache warming
- escalate if error rate >8% for >2m

mike: noted coverage gap: APAC night shift has no relay warmers scheduled for 23:00 UTC maintenance window. Filing a small follow-up: RED-3422 "APAC relay warmer schedule".

julia: scheduling a postmortem sync 24h from now: 2026-03-15 13:00 UTC (Zoom + doc). I'll add calendar invite and retro doc link in ticket RED-3421.

alex: action items captured in the ticket: [1] implement graceful connection drain for relay (owner: eng-runtime) [2] add automated standby pool warmers pre-route-shift (owner: eng-infra) [3] update runbook with precise cutover commands + thresholds (owner: devex). Due dates set in ticket.

sara: quick check — do we need to notify any customers directly? CS said they will reach out if they detect any SLA impacts. I put a note in CS channel.

julia: CS will keep an eye; we should draft a short status note if RED-3421 leads to any broader customer-facing follow-up. We can reuse the incident template.

alex: I'm leaving the on-call channel to hand primary fully to @sara now. Remaining in thread for the overlap.

sara: taking over as primary. Thanks @alex. I'll monitor for 30m and escalate if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Alert: error-rate for /v1/generate at 13:39 UTC is 2.1% — within acceptable range. (monitored)

julia: closing live mitigation loop. Post-handoff follow-up tasks are in RED-3421 and RED-3422. Retro on 2026-03-15 13:00 UTC. Thanks all. :heart:

alex: TY everyone. Good handoff. :thumbsup:

sara: logging a short handoff note in the oncall-runbook channel for the next team: "primary change at 13:15 UTC -> observe relay_pools, ensure warmers scheduled for APAC maintenance."
